arrivalDistance.description: How close is close enough, in blocks.
consume.description: The click does nothing else: a villager does not trade, a door stays shut.
exact.description: Counts only items with the same components, such as the same name or enchantments.
face.description: The side of the block it uses; the one facing it when left out.
fade.description: How long the animation blends in or out.
level.description: Where it happens; the dimension of the first player in the scene when left out.
name: Name
passDistance.description: How close to a point on the way counts as passed, in blocks.
path.description: A path as /data takes it: a.b[0].c.
points.description: The points to pass in order, [[x, y, z], ...].
pos.description: A point in the world, [x, y, z].
position.description: A point in the world, [x, y, z].
reach.description: How far it reaches, in blocks.
repathIntervalTicks.description: Ticks between looking for a new path.
speaker: Speaker
stuckTimeoutTicks.description: Ticks without progress before it counts as stuck.
targetMoveThreshold.description: How far the target moves before the path is found again, in blocks.
to.description: The players it is for; everyone in the scene when left out.
unreachableTimeoutTicks.description: Ticks of an unreachable target before giving up.
who.description: The character or entity that does it.
